نندثر (form VII)
# نَنْدَثِرُ (nandaṯiru) /nan.da.θi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَثَرَ (indaṯara)
# نَنْدَثِرَ (nandaṯira) /nan.da.θi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَثَرَ (indaṯara)
# نَنْدَثِرْ (nandaṯir) /nan.da.θir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَثَرَ (indaṯara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
